summary: Washington, D.C., IT security professional, self-taught in COBOL and VAX/VMS, avid genealogist, strong advocate for social programs and mental health support, father of five, former homeless teenager, critical of government surveillance and corporate influence, engaged in discussions about systemic issues in society, interested in astronomy and outdoor activities, experienced in remote IT work, skeptical of mainstream media, supportive of mental health awareness and accessibility, critical of immigration policies, and concerned about the impact of economic inequality on communities.
